The shelling on eastern countryside of Ain Issa

Two civilians lost their lives and two others injured due to Turkish attack on east Of Ain Issa

Two civilians have lost their lives and two others injured this morning due to a ground attack by the Turkish occupation and its mercenaries on the villages al-Mashifa and Jahbal, east of Ain Issa. The attack coincided with intensive artillery shelling targeting the area and the M4 road.
Violent clashes erupted between our forces and the mercenaries in which five mercenaries were killed. Two of the killed mercenaries are held by our forces.
This attack coincides with the terrorist attacks launched by the Daesh on al-Hasaka prison. Our forces continue efforts to secure the area and prevent Daesh detainees from escaping.
